title: B3LYP normal-cubic calibration of QM Morse exponents
summary: Refit only QM Morse exponents of a frozen GFN2 plus Delta(ZAFF) field against matched B3LYP normal-mode cubics; retain the independent GFN2 exponents and reference energy, gradient and Hessian.
gates: base field and computed F2/F3 job hashes agree
B3LYP atom order and aligned geometry agree with the composite
normal modes are matched by mass-weighted overlap and arbitrary phases are resolved explicitly
only QM Morse alphas are fitted; GFN2 third-derivative alphas remain fixed
QM Morse alphas remain positive and within one half to twice their library values
ZAFF correction energy, gradient and Hessian at G remain fixed
original library alphas and full provenance are retained
coordinate_policy: Fit the QM Morse exponents through the exact rank-one primitive-to-normal cubic response. Match B3LYP normal modes by overlap after rigid alignment and retain distinct resident GFN2 exponents.
backend_policy: Use the approved v3 two-Morse field and its same-method TRINITY F2/F3 job; use a Gaussian B3LYP Freq=Anharm log only as the cubic calibration reference.
